description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::AnyInvocable class, including various test suites for construction, assignment, invocation, and type traits, with extensive parameterization for different type properties and storage strategies.

classes.name: Wrapper
classes.description: A template class used in tests to verify constructibility and type traits.

classes.name: QualifiersForThisImpl
classes.description: A metafunction to determine the correct reference type with qualifiers for 'this'.

classes.name: GiveQualifiersToFunImpl
classes.description: A metafunction to apply cv and reference qualifiers to function types.

classes.name: TypeErasedPadding
classes.description: A dummy struct to control object size for storage tests.

classes.name: Int
classes.description: A test class with various member functions and operators used in invocable tests.

classes.name: add
classes.description: A template class representing different function object configurations for testing storage and noexcept properties.

classes.name: TestParams
classes.description: A struct encapsulating compile-time parameters for different test scenarios.

classes.name: MemberTypeOfImpl
classes.description: A metafunction to extract the target type from a member pointer.

classes.name: AnyInvTestBasic
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class template for basic tests of AnyInvocable.

classes.name: AnyInvTestCombinatoric
classes.description: A parameterized test suite for various assignment and swap operations.

classes.name: AnyInvTestMovable
classes.description: A test suite for move semantics and conversions with movable types.

classes.name: AnyInvTestNoexceptFalse
classes.description: A test suite for noexcept-conditional construction and assignment constraints when noexcept is false.

classes.name: AnyInvTestNoexceptTrue
classes.description: A test suite for noexcept-conditional constraints when noexcept is true (C++17 and later).

classes.name: AnyInvTestNonRvalue
classes.description: A test suite for non-rvalue reference qualifiers and reference wrapper conversions.

classes.name: AnyInvTestRvalue
classes.description: A test suite for rvalue reference qualifiers and related conversions.

methods.name: ToUnaryThisParam
methods.description: Converts a functor to a form suitable for 'this' parameter with qualifiers.

methods.name: ToThisParam
methods.description: Converts a functor to a form suitable for 'this' parameter with qualifiers.

methods.name: ToVoidThisParam
methods.description: Converts a functor to a form suitable for 'this' parameter with qualifiers for void return types.
